entities.name: Task
entities.description: A single unit of work the user tracks, with a title, due date, and status.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Short description of what needs to be done

fields.name: due_date
fields.description: Date by which the task should be completed; tasks without one sort last when sorting by due date

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current progress state of the task

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the task was last modified

constraints: status must be one of: todo, in_progress, done
